about: The re-ask card's strings of deck 2026-11-15.1 (sdk_4.0.0/SHARE_ASK_40.md 20.7), as translated and reviewed; read by make_decks_2026-11-15.py. card.not_now is not here: it is each deck's own sheet.not_now, word for word.

source.card.line: Your recitation today could help another learner tomorrow.

method: card.line and card.open translated by the Quran Lab router (ag/gemini-3.8-flash-high) from the English source with a translator brief (warm, humble, the deck's own voice and form of address, card.line as the reviewed reask's first sentence where it stands alone, card.open no longer than sheet.share and never a consent word), then back-translated to English in a separate call that did not see the English (ag/gemini-3.8-flash-high; ag/gemini-3.8-flash answered 403 that day); card.not_now is this deck's sheet.not_now word for word

ar.card.line: قد تساعد تلاوتك اليوم متعلماً آخر غداً.

back_translation.card.line: Your recitation today may help another learner tomorrow.

ar.drift: round 1: card.open read back as "How does that help" (a question; "See" dropped); round 2 (router, with that feedback and the 14-character limit): "Learn how it helps", kept. card.line reads back "may help" for "could help": the possibility is kept

id.card.line: Bacaan Anda hari ini bisa membantu pembelajar lain esok hari.

back_translation.card.line: Your recitation today can help other learners tomorrow.

id.drift: card.open reads back "See its benefits" (benefit for "how it helps"; same intent, kept within the 19 characters of sheet.share). card.not_now is the deck's own sheet.not_now ("Nanti saja", literally "later, then")

ms.card.line: Bacaan anda hari ini mungkin dapat membantu pembelajar lain esok.

back_translation.card.line: Your recitation today may be able to help other learners tomorrow.

ms.drift: card.open reads back "How it helps": "See" is not said ("Lihat cara ia membantu" is 22 characters, over the 18 of sheet.share); the meaning is kept

tr.card.line: Bugünkü tilavetiniz yarın bir başka öğrenciye yardımcı olabilir.

back_translation.card.line: Your recitation today can help another student tomorrow.

tr.drift: card.open reads back "How it helps": "See" is not said (the longer form is over the 20 characters of sheet.share); the meaning is kept. card.line says "student" (ogrenci), as the reviewed reask does

fr.card.line: Votre récitation d'aujourd'hui pourrait aider un autre apprenant demain.

back_translation.card.line: Your recitation today could help another learner tomorrow.

ur.card.line: آج آپ کی تلاوت سے کل کسی اور سیکھنے والے کی مدد ہو سکتی ہے۔

back_translation.card.line: Today, from your recitation, another learner can be helped tomorrow.

ur.drift: card.line reads back in the passive ("another learner can be helped"), as the reviewed reask's first sentence does; card.open reads back "See how it will help"

bn.card.line: আজকের আপনার তিলাওয়াত হয়তো আগামী দিনে অন্য কোনো শিক্ষার্থীকে সাহায্য করতে পারে।

back_translation.card.line: Your recitation today can perhaps help another learner in the coming days.

bn.drift: card.line reads back "in the coming days" for "tomorrow" and "perhaps ... can" for "could", as the reviewed reask's first sentence does
